published_ranges._plates: adhesion: hairspray, glue stick or higher bed temp
published_ranges._notes: TDS v1.0: unreinforced glycol-modified copolyester; density 1.27 g/cc (D792). Print settings PDF (0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2-0.3 mm layer) also lists 240C extruder and 90C bed as preferred values; says to lower temp or increase retraction for stringing, and that larger nozzles / higher flow / faster speeds need higher temps. Push Plastic publishes Bambu Studio PETG profiles (H2D, X1C, P1S, A1 zips) and says Bambu printers need higher-than-normal temperatures; the zip contents could not be read from this session. User spool is a factory second (seconds page: may be underweight, colour/texture may vary, some spools not AMS compatible).
